crossRefs.note: He said to her, “Please give me a little water to drink; for I am thirsty.” She opened a container of milk, and gave…

translations.web: He asked for water. She gave him milk. She brought him butter in a lordly dish.
translations.bsb: He asked for water, and she gave him milk. In a magnificent bowl she brought him curds.
translations.kjv: He asked water, and she gave him milk; she brought forth butter in a lordly dish.
translations.asv: He asked water, and she gave him milk; She brought him butter in a lordly dish.
